purpose: Seller-level facts read from each seller's own website: contact route, return window, return exclusions, resize terms, warranty. Nothing here is a reputation score: reputation claims would need independent review data, which this project did not collect, so that field is deliberately empty and flagged.

sellers.name: Blue Nile

pass12_live_check.what_the_page_shows: Contact panel lists '+1-800-242-2728', 'service@bluenile.com', a WhatsApp number and a Contact Us page link.

sellers.free_returns_limit: Two complimentary returns per customer, per year; RMA number required
sellers.resize_policy: One free resize up or down two sizes within 6 months if the design permits; eternity bands, tension rings, alternative-metal rings and some milgrain/ornate bands cannot be resized
sellers.warranty: Limited lifetime warranty on gold and platinum items with a purchase price of $1,000 or more (limitations apply)
notes: The product page also states 'Free Overnight Shipping' and 'Returns Policy' at the item level.
Every Blue Nile product page captured for this project failed to publish a gram weight.
sellers.reverification: Pass 2: /policies/returns re-fetched. 30 days from shipment, two complimentary returns per customer per year, RMA required, $150 fee for a missing grading report, one free resize up or down two sizes within 6 months, and the exclusions for personalized/custom/engraved/resized-after-purchase/clearance items all match this record.

sellers.name: Allurez
sellers.return_window_basis: The return must ARRIVE at Allurez within 30 days of the original shipment
return_exclusions: Design Your Own engagement rings (exchange only, same or higher value, not for loose diamonds)
Items that have been resized or altered
sellers.free_returns_limit: Buyer pays return shipping; original shipping cost is not refundable; RMA required
sellers.resize_policy: Not published as a free service; the included 1-year warranty covers free ring sizing
sellers.warranty: Free 1-year limited warranty included (2-year +$59, 10-year +$79, lifetime +$149 on the 14k floral setting); covers sizing, missing stones, prong tightening, polishing, rhodium plating
notes: Allurez is the only seller in this dataset whose product pages publish a gram weight for gold settings, which is why it carries most of the computable rows.
The weight is labelled 'approximate' by the seller, so derived gold values inherit that uncertainty.
sellers.reverification: Pass 2: /pages/return-policy re-fetched. Return must ARRIVE within 30 days of shipment; engraved non-refundable; Design Your Own exchange-only; custom-made non-refundable and non-cancellable; contoured bands not returnable; $300 per missing diamond certificate; refund within 7 business days; buyer pays return shipping. All match this record.

sellers.name: VRAI
sellers.return_window_basis: 30 days for eligible items; items below $15,000 can be refunded minus a recycling fee, or full store credit with the fee waived; items above $15,000 store credit only
return_exclusions: Items altered by a third party
sellers.free_returns_limit: Free return shipping in the US; refund within 14 business days of receipt
sellers.resize_policy: One complimentary resize up to one full US size; infinity and eternity bands cannot be resized
sellers.warranty: Lifetime warranty and annual shine are listed as included with the ring on the product page
notes: VRAI publishes metal weight in grams per ring size on its product pages - the most transparent weight disclosure found in this project.
The $300 engagement-ring recycling fee is waived if you accept store credit instead of a refund, so a cash refund nets less than a store credit.
sellers.reverification: Pass 2: /returns-exchanges re-fetched. 30 days; under $15,000 refund minus recycling fee or store credit, above $15,000 store credit only; $300 engagement ring, $50 wedding band ($300 if engraved), $50 made-to-order; resized and custom items excluded; free US return shipping; refund within 14 business days; one complimentary resize up to one full US size; infinity and eternity bands cannot be resized. All match this record.

sellers.free_returns_limit: Free shipping both ways (page badge "Free Shipping & Returns")

sellers.name: Anjolee
sellers.return_window_basis: Any item in its original condition within 30 days of receipt; the page states 'All customized orders can be returned for full refund within 30 days of receipt'
sellers.free_returns_limit: Free shipping and insurance on the order
sellers.warranty: Lifetime warranty (prong tightening, re-polishing, rhodium plating, cleaning) plus a one-year manufacturing-defect warranty covering diamond quality, metal, total carat weight, gemstones and craftsmanship
notes: Anjolee's written policy that customized orders can be returned for a full refund is the most buyer-friendly custom-order clause found in this dataset - get it in writing at order time anyway.

Anjolee publishes an 'Approx. Metal Weight' on its product pages. Pass 2 read 'Approx. Metal Weight: 2.90 Gr.' for MS354-A, so the earlier WEIGHT_NOT_PUBLISHED flag was incorrect and has been removed.

The MS354-A configuration priced at $870.76 carries a LAB-CREATED centre diamond ('Lab Created FG' / 'Lab Created VS'), so its price cannot be compared with setting-only prices or natural-diamond prices.
sellers.reverification: Pass 2: the product page's Warranty & Return Policy block and the site's 30-Day Returns page were re-read. Return of any item in original condition within 30 days of receipt, including the statement that 'All customized orders can be returned for full refund within 30 days of receipt'; lifetime warranty for prong tightening, re-polishing, rhodium plating and cleaning plus a one-year manufacturing-defect warranty; phone 877-265-6533. All match this record. Anjolee DOES publish a gram weight ('Approx. Metal Weight: 2.90 Gr.'), so the seller-level WEIGHT_NOT_PUBLISHED flag was wrong and has been removed. Pass 5 independently re-read the product page and confirmed the same 'Approx. Metal Weight: 2.90 Gr.', ring size 6.5, 14K white gold, and 'Center Diamond Color: Lab Created FG' / 'Clarity: Lab Created VS' in the Product Details table.

return_exclusions: Third-party resizing or repair immediately voids Lifetime Warranty
sellers.free_returns_limit: Buyer pays insured signature return shipping
sellers.resize_policy: Third-party resizing immediately voids warranty; Lifetime Warranty replacement charges max($100, 10% of purchase price)
sellers.warranty: Lifetime Warranty subject to seller inspection and max($100, 10% of purchase price) replacement fee

Line-by-line audit caught two live diamond ring pages (`SKU F1625` $20,671 & `SKU 121987-.72P` $2,858) contradicting themselves between 14K and 18K!
